name: GPT-3.5

lifecycle.note: text-davinci-002 and text-davinci-003 (InstructGPT models) and code-davinci-002 (Base GPT models) are listed with shutdown on 2024-01-04.

replacedBy.note: The deprecations page names gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct as the recommended replacement for text-davinci-002, text-davinci-003 and code-davinci-002.

sources.locator: page date; first paragraph and insert section

released.note: OpenAI released text-davinci-002 and code-davinci-002 as new versions of GPT-3 and Codex in this post. It later grouped them with text-davinci-003 as the GPT-3.5 series (model index for researchers); the series was never announced under that name.

deprecated.note: code-davinci-002 was already listed in the 2023-03-20 Codex models notice with shutdown on 2023-03-23; the 2023-07-06 notice lists it again with shutdown on 2024-01-04.

relations.note: Editorial link along the numbered GPT line: the model index describes the GPT-3.5 series as models trained on a blend of text and code from before Q4 2021, without naming a predecessor.

summary.text: GPT-3.5 is OpenAI's name for a series of API models trained on a blend of text and code from before the fourth quarter of 2021: the code completion base model code-davinci-002 and the instruction-tuned text-davinci-002 and text-davinci-003. The first two arrived in March 2022 as new versions of Codex and GPT-3; all three were shut down in January 2024.

changes.text: Trained on a blend of text and code from before the fourth quarter of 2021.
text-davinci-002 and code-davinci-002 can insert text into the middle of existing content, not only complete it.
Includes instruction-tuned models: text-davinci-002, fine-tuned on demonstrations and rated samples, and text-davinci-003, trained with reinforcement learning.

notes: A series rather than a single model. Per the model index: code-davinci-002 is a base model for code completion, text-davinci-002 an InstructGPT model based on code-davinci-002, and text-davinci-003 an improvement on text-davinci-002 trained with PPO. The model index page no longer exists and is cited from an archive capture. No primary source for the release date of text-davinci-003 was found, so it is not recorded. Context window and parameters not recorded. Lifecycle and dates apply to the API models; replacedBy assumes gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct is covered by the GPT-3.5 Turbo record.
